svg.title: Diagnose, repair, then restart a user service.
svg.desc: For the prepared web-demo.service, selected illustrative failure evidence maps to concrete fields: failure to execute points to ExecStart, failure to change directory to WorkingDirectory, occupied port to the listener, and incorrect content to the served directory. Read state and messages first, repair the cause, verify and reload the unit, conditionally reset a repeated-start limit, then restart. Every command is complete and scoped to the user's unit. Resetting clears the recorded limit, not the underlying cause.
svg.text: For prepared web-demo.service: read state and messages; repair the cause first.
port occupied; never stop unknown processes
served directory and file, not just state
Start limit = too many starts in a short time. If reached, clear it AFTER repair:
then check state, logs and page
